tactics:
induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih => intro acc; simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]; apply bind_congr; intro o; cases o <;> simp [ih (acc := _ :: _), ih (acc := acc)]

induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]; congr; funext o; cases o <;> simp [ih (acc := _ :: _), ih (acc := acc)]
